From the viewpoint that all impacts are attributable to the AFES, gasoline savings for all NPA's except recreational-type NPA's with off-road capability can be determined based on an average of 11,000 miles per year per vehicle, a lifetime of 10 years, a fleet size (domestic and captive imports) of 1,060,000 new vehicles, and a baseline 1976 production weighted average fleet fuel economy of 16.1 mpg. The annual consumption of gasoline per vehicle for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1976 of 16.1 mpg is 683 gallons. The annual consumption of gasoline for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 17.8 mpg is 618 gallons. The annual consumption of gasoline for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 18.7 mpg is 588 gallons. Thus, the annual savings of gasoline per vehicle would be between 65 gallons and 95 gallons and the lifetime savings would be between 650 gallons and 950 gallons. The annual consumption in MY 1976 for the fleet is 724 million gallons. The annual consumption in MY 1979 for the fleet would be between 555.1 million gallons and 623.3 million gallons for standards between 17.8 and 18.7 mpg respectively.
